name: Fiona
title: Protective holy knight
subtitle: Knight & Paladin of Aureth
summary: Fiona is a brave and protective knight who serves Aureth. Her holy abilities center on battlefield healing, radiant swordsmanship, and instinctively shielding others. Her golden paladin armor responds most strongly when she acts out of protectiveness.
details: Knight and paladin of Aureth, Goddess of Magic.

powers.name: Battlefield Healing
powers.description: Channels holy magic to heal or stabilize allies during battle. Exact healing dice and number of uses remain to be established.

powers.name: Brass Wings of Protection
powers.description: The brass wings connected to Fiona’s golden paladin armor awaken in moments of protection or protectiveness and can wrap around Fiona or shield up to two other people.
powers.usesRange: Self or up to 2 others; uses TBD

powers.name: Wind-Harnessed Glide
powers.description: Uses the wings to glide from high places or ride strong updrafts; cannot take off from level ground, hover, or maintain powered flight.

relationships: Bonded in holy service to Aureth, Goddess of Magic. Recognized by the dwarves through the Feast of Ancestors honor and carries a ceremonial ticket granting entry or favor.
specialRules: Golden Paladin Armor provides holy protection. Fiona’s sword can ward off undead; exact mechanical bonuses are TBD.
attackRules: Demon Banishment can return demons to the Nine Hells, but the required hit, saving throw, damage threshold, and usage limit are TBD. Undead Warding radius, duration, and save are TBD.
sessionNotes: The source notes a handwritten jewelry addition, but its details are not clear enough to confirm. Other unclear handwritten markings remain unresolved.
